name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Stand with feet stable and dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace the abdomen and press the weights overhead.
Finish with arms extended and ribs stacked above the pelvis.
Lower under control to shoulder height.
cues: Let the shoulder blades rotate upward.
mistakes: Leaning back to turn the movement into an incline press.
breathing: Exhale as you press; inhale as you lower.
adaptation: Standing variation of the source seated press; muscle data retained; no bench required.
